source: Dana Vrabelová, Imago gratiosa. Korunované Madony ve střední Evropě v době baroka / Crowned Madonnas in Central Europe in the Baroque Period. Dissertation, Charles University, Prague, 2013. § XXI (p. 223), chronological table of thirty coronations by the Chapter of St Peter's in Baroque Central Europe, 1717–1786; per-image ACSP folio citations from the footnotes of her §§ X–XVII.
note: Names in `title_vernacular` are the standard modern forms (Polish, Czech, Lithuanian); `title_as_given` is her Czech form. `register_refs` are her citations of BAV, ACSP, Madonne coronate (sv. = tomo). Where she cites no folio for an image this is stated. All rows are SECONDARY: reported by the thesis, not read here at first hand.

rows.notes: Unnamed in her table; identified from her § 13.5.7 (Matka Boží Szydłowická; petition of Jan Dominik Łopaciński approved by the Chapter in 1775). Szydłów is the Polish name of Šiluva.
